THEATRE REVIEW THE QUEENS

Monday, November 09, 1992

ROBERT CUSHMAN

Toronto ONT -- WRITTEN BY NORMAND CHAURETTE "DIRECTED BY PETER HINTON At the Canadian Stage Theatre at Berkeley Street Norman Chaurette's play brings together the female survivors from Shakespeare's Richard III for an airing of royal grievances The Queens merely chatter ROBERT CUSHMAN Special to the Globe and Mail Toronto I am reviewing this show against the expressed preferences of the Canadian Stage Company. The production inaugurates a scheme of Advanced Workshopping: audiences will be canvassed for their opinions so that authors, directors and performers may learn from them. To keep these reactions free and uncontaminated, critics are being discouraged until late in the run. There is much sense in this. Spectators can be conditioned by reading reviews, though the logic of CSC's position would be to ban critics altogether. There is a lot to be said for this, though less than there is to be said against it.
